findings.summary: Sample check R1 coverage gap: AT1 tests rejecting chat logs and unapproved non-canonical inputs, but it does not test the “accept exactly one frozen plan_package_final.json” constraint (e.g., behavior when multiple plan_package_final.json inputs are provided, or when multiple versions/duplicates are present). This weakens traceability that R1’s “exactly one” requirement is enforced.

evidence.note: R1 includes “accept exactly one frozen plan_package_final.json”
evidence.quote: The Implementation Council subsystem SHALL accept exactly one frozen plan_package_final.json

evidence.note: AT1 procedures do not include a multi-input/duplicate plan_package_final.json case
evidence.quote: Attempt to initiate an Implementation Council run with inputs: (a) a valid plan_package_final.json

findings.summary: Sample checks R1–R3 depend on Intake correctly validating inputs and recording outcomes, but Intake tool policy restricts artifact_write to “allow_noncanonical_only”, while M1 deliverables require initializing canonical artifacts (implementation_run_manifest.json, implementation_event_log.jsonl, workspace_index.json, and stage_handoff). This internal inconsistency can block or undermine the intended R1–R3 validation/audit behavior at Intake.

evidence.note: Intake restrictions appear to disallow canonical artifact writes
M1 requires run manifest initialization during Intake milestone
M1 requires workspace_index initialization during Intake milestone
evidence.quote: workspace_index.json initialized with namespace/partition layout per workspace_context.json.

evidence.note: M1 requires stage_handoff emission at Intake→Parallel boundary

findings.summary: Sample checks for R2 and R3 assert “typed, versioned schema” requirements for repo_context.json and workspace_context.json, and AT2/AT3 assume schema validation exists, but the candidate does not provide explicit schema artifact identifiers/locations or versioning scheme for those schemas within the plan package itself. This leaves a trace gap: the requirements are stated, but the concrete schema sources to be validated are not evidenced in this artifact.

evidence.note: R2 requires a typed, versioned repo_context.json schema
evidence.quote: SHALL define and require a typed, versioned repo_context.json schema

evidence.note: R3 requires a typed, versioned workspace_context.json schema
evidence.quote: SHALL define and require a typed, versioned workspace_context.json schema

evidence.note: AT2 assumes a schema exists to validate against, but schema artifact ref is not specified here
evidence.quote: Start a run without repo_context.json; then start a run with repo_context.json that violates schema

evidence.note: AT3 assumes a schema exists to validate against, but schema artifact ref is not specified here
evidence.quote: Start a run without workspace_context.json; then start a run with schema-invalid workspace_context.json
